{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python - <<'PY'
p="specs/001-transactions/spec.md"
s=open(p).read()
old_in='**Input**: User description: "Build cachetools.tagged.TaggedCache(maxsize), using the existing\nLRUCache for bounded storage and preserving all existing cachetools APIs. R01-R03\nplus Claim-A candidate extension (variant put_no_recency_refresh, 2026-09-21)."'
new_in='**Input**: User description: "cachetools milestone 1 (R01-R03) + Claim-A put_no_recency_refresh\n(2026-09-21); cachetools milestone 2 (R04-R06) + Claim-A round 2 R05 clarification\n(2026-09-22). Build cachetools.tagged.TaggedCache(maxsize) on the existing LRUCache,\npreserving all existing cachetools APIs. Earlier requirements R01-R03 are retained."'
assert old_in in s
s=s.replace(old_in,new_in)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("input updated")
PY"}
